book: Jacobus Aubertus, Institutiones physicae (Lyon, Antonius de Harsy, 1584): a Latin natural-philosophy textbook in four numbered parts (prima pars, secunda pars meteorologia, tertia pars on the soul, postrema pars on the common affections of soul and body), each divided into capita, preceded by a dedication, an Epistola, commendatory verses and a general introduction on the division of philosophy.
